sequenceDiagram

## Notes on accuracy

- The two `Note over` boxes mark MEASURED truncation points on this exact path.
  `build_call_graph()` constructs `CallGraphBuilder` with no `max_files` argument, so
  the 300-file default binds: a default pipeline run of this sequence sees 300 of 411
  files and zero of the 45 `sdlc_pipeline` files. `compute_call_paths()` additionally
  caps at 500 paths, which binds even when the file cap is lifted.
- The 13 `generate_*` self-calls are drawn in the order they appear in `generate_all()`.
  The first 7 are called directly; the last 6 are invoked through a list of lambdas at
  `legacy_generator.py:989-994`. That indirection is flattened here.
- `AA->>UG` (UMLAstAnalyzer) is a per-file call inside `_classes_from_call_graph`; it is
  shown once rather than in a loop to keep the lifeline readable.
